dcterms:description: The Vader corpus contains 4,000 tweets pulled from Twitter’s public timeline, independently annotated by 20 human raters with sentiment ratings in a range of [-4, 4]. The continuous human-assigned ratings are discretized to discrete numbers [-2, -1, ..., 2] for compatibility with the task context.
dcterms:title: Vader Corpus
